tags.lyrics-eng:
Do you think about me now and then?
Like you know I do,
about you

Well I’m up till 4am just wondering,
if you wanna talk,
like I do
For many years now,
and time is running fast
But this sense will last forever
I wanna feel your touch, I want your caress
With your tenderness and passion, I might be stupid
I might be dumb,
or just playing games in my mind
But I hope we get our time
To live our little world, side by side

Conquering the world, in this lifetime
Time is running out,
for both of us to choose to move or just stand still
Well it’s up to you babe, cause you know I will

You wish that sooner that you promised me
It’s time to lock us up, so we can leave
Don’t think you know you got the end of me
You know you played your part,
definitely
I might be stupid,
I might be dumb,
or just playing games in my mind
But I hope we get our time
To live our little world, side by side

Conquering the world, in this lifetime
Time is running out,
for both of us to choose to move or just stand still
Well it’s up to you boy, cause you know I will
And you know it’s true, all the songs that we write are just for me and for you
Sense my urgency,
cause if life’s not long, I won’t let you move
So let’s live our little world, side by side

Conquering the world, in this lifetime

Time is running out,
for both of us to choose to move or just stand still
Well it’s up to you boy, cause you know I, well it’s up to you boy, cause you know I, well it’s up to you boy, cause you know I will
